object.script:
local current_value = 0
function onTick() local plusOne = input.getBool(1) local minusOne = input.getBool(2) local plusBlink = input.getBool(3) local minusBlink = input.getBool(4) local reset = input.getBool(5)
if reset then if current_value >= 40 then current_value = 39 else if current_value >= 22 then current_value = 21 else current_value = 0 end end else if plusOne then if current_value < 56 then if current_value < 21 then current_value = current_value + 1 else if current_value == 21 then current_value = 22 else if current_value < 39 then current_value = current_value + 1 else if current_value == 39 then current_value = 40 else current_value = current_value + 1 end end end end end else if minusOne then if current_value > 0 then if current_value == 22 then current_value = 21 else if current_value == 40 then current_value = 39 else current_value = current_value - 1 end end end else if plusBlink then if current_value < 56 then if current_value < 21 then current_value = current_value + 1 else if current_value == 21 then current_value = 22 else if current_value < 39 then current_value = current_value + 1 else if current_value == 39 then current_value = 40 else current_value = current_value + 1 end end end end end else if minusBlink then if current_value > 0 then if current_value == 22 then current_value = 21 else if current_value == 40 then current_value = 39 else current_value = current_value - 1 end end end end end end end end
output.setNumber(1, current_value) end
